title: French Pesto Pasta
description: A classic French pasta dish with a twist of umami flavor. Quick to make and packed with flavor.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a food processor, blend aji, umami, and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add crunchy and cook until fragrant.
Add the pesto sauce to the pan and stir to combine.
Add cooked pasta to the pan and toss to coat with pesto sauce.
Top with parmesan cheese and garnish with parsley.
